title: Why your lower back hurts after a long day at a desk — physio tips from Hanamkonda
summary: Desk job in Hanamkonda or Warangal? Our physiotherapists explain the posture habits behind stiffness and 2 stretches to try between meetings.
body:
Most desk-related lower back pain in our Hanamkonda clinic is not caused by one bad position. It builds up quietly — a chair too low, a screen at the wrong height, a laptop balanced on a lap during long work hours common in Warangal offices.

Start with the two movements that help most people most quickly. First, gentle knee-to-chest rocking, lying on your back with both knees bent, for one minute at a time. Second, a hip-flexor stretch, because tight hips make the lower back work harder just to stand up straight.

If the pain wakes you at night, travels down the leg (possible sciatica), or comes with numbness or weakness, book an assessment at Healing Hands Advanced Physiotherapy Clinic, Advocate's Colony Main Road, Hanamkonda — we treat back pain, disc bulge and sciatica every day. Call +91 85238 41691 or see our What We Treat page.

title: Ankle sprain? Here's what to do in the first 48 hours — Warangal sports physio guide
summary: How to manage a fresh sprain at home in Warangal, and when to visit Healing Hands Hanamkonda for an assessment.
body:
The first two days decide how long a sprain takes to settle. Protect it, rest it, ice it in the early phase, compress it and keep it elevated above hip height as much as you can.

Keep weight off the ankle for the first day or two, then begin gentle range-of-movement work as soon as swelling settles. Movement early prevents the stiffness that makes ankle sprains drag on for months — something we see often in cricket and football players from Hanamkonda, Kazipet and Warangal.

Visit Healing Hands Advanced Physiotherapy Clinic, Hanamkonda if you cannot take four steps, if there is bony tenderness over the ankle knobs, or if swelling has not clearly improved after a week. We offer sports physiotherapy, taping and manual therapy. Call +91 85238 41691.

title: What to expect in your first physiotherapy session in Hanamkonda
summary: From assessment to treatment plan — a walkthrough of your first visit to Healing Hands, Warangal.
body:
Your first session at Healing Hands Advanced Physiotherapy Clinic, Hanamkonda is mostly conversation and assessment. We ask what happened, how it affects your day, and what you have already tried. Then we look at how you move.

You will be shown a few movements so we can watch your posture, hip and shoulder mechanics, and strength. Nothing in this stage should be painful.

You leave with a clear plan: what we will work on, roughly how many sessions (basic treatment Rs. 400, manual therapy Rs. 500), and two or three exercises to start at home. title: Sciatica treatment in Warangal: symptoms, causes & when physio helps
summary: Burning leg pain, numbness, tingling from back to foot? A Hanamkonda physiotherapist explains sciatica and how manual therapy + exercise fix it.
body:
Sciatica is one of the most common reasons patients visit our Hanamkonda clinic from across Warangal, Kazipet and Hasanparthy. Typical signs: sharp or burning pain from the buttock down the back of the leg, numbness, tingling, pain worse on sitting or coughing.

Common causes we assess for: disc bulge, piriformis tightness, spinal stenosis and prolonged sitting. Treatment at Healing Hands includes manual therapy, neural mobilisation, dry needling where indicated, traction and a progressive exercise plan — not just painkillers.

Seek early assessment if pain travels below the knee, if there is foot weakness, or if bladder/bowel changes occur (emergency). For most sciatica, 6-10 physio sessions make a clear difference. Book at Healing Hands, Hanamkonda — call +91 85238 41691. Read What We Treat for related back conditions.

title: Frozen shoulder treatment in Hanamkonda: stages & recovery timeline
summary: Can't lift your arm or sleep on your side? Our Warangal physios explain frozen shoulder stages and how manual therapy restores movement.
body:
Frozen shoulder (adhesive capsulitis) freezes slowly — freezing (painful, 2-6 months), frozen (stiff, 4-12 months), thawing (gradual recovery). We treat many cases from Hanamkonda and Warangal, especially in diabetics and post-injury stiffness.

Physiotherapy focuses on pain relief first (electrotherapy, hot packs), then graded mobilisation, manual therapy, cupping and home pendular and wall-crawl exercises. Most patients regain functional movement in 8-16 weeks with consistent sessions.

Don't force painful overhead movements or get aggressive massage. If night pain is severe or you can't dress yourself, visit Healing Hands Advanced Physiotherapy Clinic, Hanamkonda. Call +91 85238 41691. Manual therapy Rs. 500, basic Rs. 400.

title: Knee pain & arthritis in Warangal: does physiotherapy avoid surgery?
summary: Knee arthritis, meniscus or IT-band pain? How physiotherapy in Hanamkonda strengthens knees and delays knee replacement.
body:
Knee pain — osteoarthritis, patellofemoral pain, ligament sprains — keeps many Warangal patients from walking, stairs and prayer sitting. Physiotherapy at Healing Hands Hanamkonda targets the real drivers: weak quadriceps and glutes, stiff hamstrings and calves, poor foot mechanics.

A typical plan: electrotherapy for pain, manual therapy for stiffness, taping, then progressive strengthening (quad sets, straight-leg raises, glute bridges, step-ups) plus weight and footwear advice. Many early-moderate arthritis patients delay or avoid surgery with 8-12 weeks of consistent physio.

If there is locking, giving-way, large swelling after injury, or severe bow-leg deformity, get assessed quickly. Visit us at Balasamudram, Hanamkonda, Warangal 506001. Call +91 85238 41691.

title: Neck pain & cervical spondylosis from mobile use — Warangal physio's fix
summary: Stiff neck, headaches, tingling in hands from phone/laptop use? Posture correction + manual therapy in Hanamkonda that actually lasts.
body:
Text-neck is epidemic in Hanamkonda and Warangal — hours bent over phones and laptops cause neck pain, headaches, shoulder tightness and hand tingling (cervical radiculopathy).

What helps: chin-tucks, deep-neck-flexor training, thoracic extension over a chair, workstation height correction, and manual therapy for stiff cervical and upper-thoracic joints. Dry needling helps stubborn trigger points in the trapezius.

At Healing Hands we combine assessment of posture, nerve tension tests and ergonomic advice with hands-on treatment. Basic treatment Rs. 400, manual Rs. 500. If there is arm weakness, severe numbness or gait disturbance, seek prompt evaluation. Book in Hanamkonda — +91 85238 41691.
